coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of five ground-truth variable items are matched (60%): JaxMARL/SMAX with fixed hardware and resources, the MAPPO versus QMIX comparison, and wall-clock time to a defined performance threshold. Timing is primarily reported in seconds rather than minutes, but is convertible.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design selects six maps instead of nine and includes maps with more than 10 units. Its normalized score subtracts a random baseline and divides by an expert-minus-random baseline, rather than dividing the algorithm score by the scenario maximum. It also expands the algorithm comparison with IPPO and VDN.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output omits both expected findings: PPO trains 6× faster than Q-Learning and achieves higher normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios because of greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
